title: Skydive Perris
specs: West Coast’s largest and most trusted skydiving center
Closest skydiving center to Hollywood, chosen by A Listers and VIPs
Onsite wind tunnel, one of the world’s only DZs with this feature
Industry’s safest and most reliable aircraft including rear-exit tailgate jump ships
Must have a B license or more and attend the Night Jump briefing to do night jumps

options.name: Tandem Skydive
options.detail: Jump from 14,000 feet MSL securely attached to a tandem skydiving instructor with 60 seconds freefall and 5-10 minute parachute ride.

options.name: Tandem Skydive from 18,000 feet
options.detail: Jump from 18,000 feet MSL using supplemental oxygen with 90 seconds freefall.

options.name: DC-9 Tandem Skydive
options.detail: Jump from the only DC-9 airliner jet in the world rated for skydiving, exiting by the tail door.

options.name: Bronze Package
options.detail: Two one-minute flights in onsite indoor wind tunnel, training, gear, instructor support, and flight certificate included.

options.name: Platinum Package
options.detail: Five one-minute flights in onsite indoor wind tunnel plus a high flight, training, gear, and flight certificate included.
